title: Agents That Self Improve While You Sleep - Fuad Ali, Arize AI
talk_summary: Arize PM Fuad Ali demos a self-improvement loop where an always-on agent (Signal) reads production traces on a schedule, clusters failures into one ticket per problem, proposes a code fix as a PR, and auto-generates evals plus a growing 'living fixture' dataset that is replayed against the fix to prove it works and nothing regressed. Humans are kept only at high-leverage points: validating the fix, curating the dataset, and designing evals.

takeaways.what_they_do: Every failure the trace-review agent finds is added to a dataset that grows over time; each new failure mode becomes a permanent regression case replayed on future fixes.
takeaways.evidence_quote: living fixtures that change over time as you add new use cases, as you see new failure modes

takeaways.technique: Trace-driven defect clustering into one ticket per problem
takeaways.what_they_do: An always-on agent reads traces on a schedule, clusters failures, dedupes so one ticket per problem, and writes root-cause analysis against the source repo before proposing a fix.
takeaways.evidence_quote: It keeps one ticket per problem uh the way a reviewer would. So, you're not getting hundreds and hundreds of issues
takeaways.numbers: Signal ran 6 minutes to find root cause in repo

takeaways.what_they_do: Replay the failure fixture set against the patched agent version, score with evals, and only merge if it clears a threshold and doesn't regress other evals.
Track each eval's pass rate and cost; retire evals passing ~99.99% (wasted tokens) and harden ones in poor health; sample evals on prod traces rather than 100%.
takeaways.evidence_quote: if this eval is passing 99.999% of the time maybe we don't want to spend the tokens on this eval

takeaways.technique: Cheap decision models for classification evals
takeaways.what_they_do: Use small 'decision' models that return typed choices plus explicit confidence scores for trace checks, far cheaper than LLM-judge, and route low-confidence cases to humans.
takeaways.evidence_quote: they are a very, very cheap way to run some of these checks on your traces versus um using a classic LLM
takeaways.numbers: spam example: 4.6% of cases scored 0.3-0.7 confidence routed to humans, 99.5% accuracy

takeaways.technique: Meta-loop: run the reviewer on its own traces
takeaways.what_they_do: The trace-review agent's own runs are traced and reviewed by another instance, using proxy metrics like PR merge rate and dataset/eval creation as ground-truth-free feedback.
